issues.reason: Being caught up in a debate neither creates, destroys, consumes nor changes the planning (and "catch up in" is not one of the occurrence-altering verbs cancel / postpone / delay / reschedule that the non-physical extension names), so the stated test — Patient only when the object itself changes, otherwise Theme, and Theme when unclear — puts the passive subject in Theme.

notes: The local_resident fusion left as parsed: "local" is an adjective predicable of the referent, so if the pair fuses the modifier genus is required, and the parse emits it. The nominalization obliques (For, Of, About, On) and the 's-genitive Possession are all licensed.
